title: OfertaCandidate
description: Extrator candidate before domain match-or-create (produto/marca labels, not ids)

produto.description: Brand-agnostic sellable type label (e.g. Arroz integral)

marca.description: Optional brand label; omit when the flyer has no brand

categorias.description: Taxonomic labels for the Produto (not sellable-type variants)

quantidades.description: Package sizes sharing this price (same medida); discrete list from flyer, e.g. [90, 150, 200]

medida.description: Always normalized by Extrator: kg→1000g, L→1000ml; shared by all quantidades

dataInicio.description: Start of flyer validity for this Oferta (YYYY-MM-DD); may be in the future

dataExpiracao.description: End of flyer validity for this Oferta (YYYY-MM-DD); may be in the past (history)

promocao.description: Optional commercial condition: valorPromocional plus channel (cartao XOR clube) and/or quantity mechanic (leve+pague XOR quantidadePromocao). At least one of channel or mechanic required; both may compose when they share the same price (ADR 0032).

comparativo.description: Optional pack-fraction / unit-price badge (e.g. 'nesta embalagem 800 g sai por R$ 4,98'). Not Promoção and not a second Oferta. Medida inherited from parent Oferta; quantidade must be < min(quantidades) (ADR 0035).
